mechanism_narrative: A sustained 4-quarter rise in real GDP growth above 3.5% signals accelerating demand, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations rise.
failure_condition: If 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of quarters when GDPC1 growth exceeds 3.5%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the industrial production index below its 12-month moving average signals weakening manufacturing output, which historically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as profit margins compress.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below its 12-month moving average, the hypothesis is rejected.
